mission.posting: #CLIENT# is looking to aid their currently struggling staff recruitment effort by redirecting some applications for a rival company to their email.

email.subject: Recruitment Drive
email.body:
Agent,
Lately our company has been struggling with finding new staff, mostly due to the overwhelmingly successful recruitment efforts made by some of our competitors. We'd like to level the playing field, but temporarily redirecting some of their recruitment traffic to us.
Their hiring website is located at the given link below. We'd like you to replace their contact email address with our own:
#LC_CLIENT#@jmail.com
-#CLIENT#
